ItemID: unavailable; Title: Testify; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rap-rock direction is less appealing right now than the heavier melodic sound I want.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Stone Sour       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The mix of heavy riffs and melody fits, but other albums here interest me more this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its aggressive sound and melodic hooks fit my interest in heavier music alongside accessible hard rock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The intricate guitar work and melodic metal appeal to my interest in Advance And Vanquish and recent Tool listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Lost and Found       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves suit my taste, but I am more curious about the melodic metal choices today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Death-Grip On Yesterday; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The balance of aggression and melody sounds appealing, though it would wait behind my first choices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Crusade; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its thrash-oriented riffs sound like a strong fit with my interest in Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Faceless       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The forceful hard-rock sound fits One Day Remains and Ten Thousand Fists, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Fall of Ideals; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Melodic guitar lines with harsh vocals strongly appeal to the In Flames and Soilwork side of my listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rhythmic shifts and heavy hooks fit my current interests, but I would save it for another visit.
